verdict.line: You lose if you tap Riposte early or stand in extended melee before level 6; you win if you save Riposte for his grab and punish the whiff.

brief.thesis: Sett's entire threat is compressed into two commitment abilities, E (Facebreaker) and R (The Show Stopper), both of which are single-target grabs that W (Riposte) fully negates. Everything else he does — Q (Knuckle Down) empowered punches, passive Grit healing — is manageable auto-attack pressure that Fiora out-scales once vitals start proc'ing. The matchup is decided by whether you burn Riposte on his pokes or hold it for the grab.

theirWindow.when: Grit bar full and E (Facebreaker) off cooldown
theirWindow.what: This is his all-in: full Grit means his next auto is empowered and heals him, and E lets him yank you in for a stun into that empowered hit plus Q punches. Don't stand in melee range while his bar climbs — back up a step and force him to walk up before he's ready.

yourWindow.when: immediately after you parry his E or R with Riposte
yourWindow.what: His grab, his stun, and often his Grit payoff are all wasted in one W. Chain Bladework (E) empowered autos into his revealed vitals right away — he has no escape and no CC left to punish the follow-up.

start.why: Blunts his early auto-attack poke and passive-fueled trades so you aren't forced to burn Riposte before level 3 just to survive.

boots.why: Every point of his damage — autos, empowered Q punches, E/R grab damage — is physical; flat armor plus the auto-attack reduction directly blunts his all-in burst.

core.why: Sheen burst and movement speed help you stick through his engage range and disengage after landing a Riposte punish.
Cleave for wave management plus lifesteal that competes directly with his Grit-fueled self-healing in extended trades.
Converts his grab-combo burst into a damage-over-time tick, so your own sustain outpaces it during and after his all-in window.

situational.when: his Grit and empowered-auto healing is outpacing the damage you're landing
you're already ahead in lane and want insurance against a coordinated dive
he's building bruiser HP and his all-in burst threatens to one-round you through Riposte's cooldown

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the exact fight pattern this matchup wants — win extended skirmishes by outlasting his Grit sustain, and the healing on stacks compounds with your vitals procs.

summoners.why: Flash lets you reposition out of his E/R grab range or close distance right after a Riposte parry; Teleport keeps you relevant to sidewaves since this lane is won on skill windows, not early kill pressure.

playing.title: Hold Riposte for the grab
playing.detail: Never spend W (Riposte) on his basic auto poke pre-6. Save it exclusively for E (Facebreaker) or R (The Show Stopper) — blocking either voids his entire all-in.

playing.title: Poke with Lunge, don't melee trade
playing.detail: Use Q (Lunge) to proc vitals and reset distance instead of standing in auto range, since prolonged melee contact is exactly what fills his Grit meter.

playing.title: Back off when Grit is near full
playing.detail: A near-capped Grit bar means his next auto is empowered and heals him; step out of range and make him walk up before it triggers.

playing.title: Chain Bladework after a parry
playing.detail: The instant Riposte lands, use E (Bladework) empowered autos into his revealed vitals — his CC and burst are gone and he can't answer.

playing.title: Avoid the 3-5 all-in window
playing.detail: Play for freezes and short trades rather than extended fights right after he unlocks E; this is his single strongest kill window before your Riposte timing is proven.

playing.title: Prioritize Grievous Wounds if losing sustain
playing.detail: If his Grit and empowered-auto healing keeps winning trades on HP totals, rush Mortal Reminder rather than more raw damage.

brief.patchCaveat: Item names (Trinity Force, Ravenous Hydra, Death's Dance, Mortal Reminder) and exact rune shard options can shift between seasons — verify current builds in-client. The core interaction that defines this matchup, W (Riposte) fully negating Sett's E (Facebreaker) and R (The Show Stopper) grabs, has held stable across many patches, but double-check current numbers on 16.18.1 before committing to this plan.
